prompt: A production Minecraft texture atlas of ORIGINAL ECOSYSTEM GROUND TOP SURFACES. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows of square equal-sized tiles, edge-to-edge square atlas, no labels, borders or gutters. Every tile is a TOP-DOWN seamless flat organic ground texture in authentic current vanilla Minecraft 16x16 logical pixel art, uniformly enlarged with nearest neighbour. Use restrained clustered pixels and mottled irregular patches, low contrast, completely opaque. ABSOLUTELY NO side view, NO hanging grass blades, NO vertical wood grain, NO tree bark, NO logs or perspective. These tiles cover horizontal ground in a game, like moss blocks and grass block tops. Tile order left to right top to bottom: 1 olive green broad moss with curled tiny earthy leaves; 2 pale seafoam fluffy moss with pearl specks; 3 dark muted blue-green conifer litter with little tan needles; 4 ochre and amber speckled cave moss with tiny brown pores; 5 dusty burgundy red and copper tiny curled leaf litter; 6 muted teal marsh loam with dark olive damp patches; 7 slate blue lichen with dark plum leaf specks; 8 dusty apricot and mauve fragmented leaf litter; 9 pale lilac and steel blue hanging moss seen flat from above; 10 earthy terracotta soil with subdued jade green moss islands. Remaining six tiles are matching drier earthy variations of tiles 1-6. Each tile fills its whole square, modest coherent colour ramps, hand-placed-looking clustered pixels, no smooth shading, no glossy lighting, no neon or text. All sixteen squares are ground viewed straight DOWN, not sideways.
